giver: Anglers' society: fishermen in every village (pooled representatives); in Reece, Commodore Wren Halloway, the society's president. Rival: Silas Pike, a boastful champion angler who turns up wherever you fish.
feel: A season of fishing competitions: heats in rivers, jungles, reefs and the open sea against a rival who cheats a little, legendary catches, and a grand championship at the end.

quests.title: Entry Form
quests.summary: Commodore Halloway in Reece signs you up for the society's season, if you can land five fish of any kind with a plain rod before sundown and show her the catch.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a stack of worms, the season's fixture card

quests.title: Bait and Tackle
quests.summary: A fisherman teaches you the society's kit: build a worm farm, raise worms for bait and craft a tackle box to keep hooks and bobbers in.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a bobber and fishing line

quests.title: A Rival on the Bank
quests.summary: Silas Pike strolls up while you're fishing and sneers at your rod: he bets you can't hook the old carp everyone on this bank calls Grandfather. Keep fishing until it bites (a quest item, only catchable while the bet is on).

quests.title: The Opening Cup
quests.summary: The first competition of the season, held at the nearest fishing hut: the cup goes to whoever lands the society's ribboned trout. Fish the hut's water until it bites (a quest item). The winner wears the lucky angler's hat until next year (or for good, says the Commodore).

quests.title: Tally Book
quests.summary: The society keeps a lifetime tally for every member: reach a hundred fish caught to be ranked for the summer heats.

quests.title: The River Heat
quests.summary: Heat one runs along a river: catch a brown trout, a smallmouth bass, a bluegill and a perch, and keep fishing until you land the heat's marked fish (a quest item).
quests.reward: Fishing XP, an iron fishing rod

quests.title: Hooked
quests.summary: Silas wins the heat on a technicality and brags about his hooks; craft your own light, heavy and double hooks and fit them to an iron rod so the next heat is fair.

quests.title: Traps and Nets
quests.summary: Not every angler sits with a rod: build Lili's fish trap and fishing net, set them in a pond overnight and bring the haul to a fisherman.

quests.title: The Keeper's Ledger
quests.summary: The season's record book is kept by the keeper of a lighthouse on the coast; carry a fresh cod meal there and read the records, including one of Silas's that looks forged.

quests.title: Message in a Bottle
quests.summary: A message in a bottle comes up on your line: a drowned angler's note about a stash on a nearby beach. Follow it and dig up the lockbox.

quests.title: Beach Weigh-in
quests.summary: The coastal heat ends with a party at a beach hut: catch three tropical fish, grill them Lili's way and serve the judges before the sun goes down.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a fish trophy frame

quests.title: The Rod at the Bottom
quests.summary: The society's heirloom rod went over the side of a boat in the deepest lake around, and Silas swears it wasn't him. Dive to the bottom for it before your air runs out; the old diver's snorkel is yours afterwards.

quests.title: Net Thieves
quests.summary: Fish keep vanishing from the society's nets at a fishing hut. Follow the feathers and tracks to a seagull flock nesting nearby and drive them off.

quests.title: Between the Buoys
quests.summary: Silas challenges you to a swim, no boats: out around the buoys of the harbour and back to the jetty before him. The race-master's flippers go to the winner.

quests.title: Teeth in the River
quests.summary: The jungle heat: land an arapaima, a tambaqui and a piranha from a jungle river, and the heat's marked fish (a quest item), without being bitten to the bone.

quests.title: Oasis Heat
quests.summary: A heat on the desert rivers: bring back a bayad, a boulti and a capitaine, the society's three 'river of sand' fish.

quests.title: Colours of the Reef
quests.summary: The society wants a living display: bucket a clownfish, a seahorse and a moorish idol from a warm reef; the society builds the aquarium around them in Reece.

quests.title: The Fisherman Who Left
quests.summary: Out at sea, an outcast fisherman lives on his little boat and knows the deep-water spots; find him and match his catch of tuna, red grouper and halibut to earn a place in the deep-sea heat.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a stack of leeches

quests.title: Poachers Afloat
quests.summary: A pillager ship is dragging nets through the society's fishing grounds; sail out, board it and clear its crew.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a lockbox of stolen gear

quests.title: Neptune's Bounty
quests.summary: The outcast fisherman says the sea gives up treasure to the patient: fish up Neptune's Bounty, open it and forge your first neptunium.

quests.title: The Captain's Logbook
quests.summary: The poachers' logbook names a wreck where they hid the society's old trophies; find the shipwreck and salvage them.

quests.title: The Lantern Heat
quests.summary: A heat held only at night: fit a glowstone hook and fish after dark for jellyfish, then for the glowing heat token that only bites under the stars (a quest item).

quests.title: Waters Over the Ruins
quests.summary: Forge a neptunium rod and fish above a sunken ruin where the best fish gather, while drowned rise from the ruin to cut your line.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a neptunium fillet knife

quests.title: The Sunken Hind
quests.summary: The Ceryneian Hind sank with the society's championship purse aboard, and everything worth having lies on the sea floor around it. Clear the wreck, find the diver's charm in the captain's cabin and walk the bottom to recover the purse.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, the Charm of Sinking

quests.title: Ghosts on the Fishing Grounds
quests.summary: Fishermen whisper of an undead pirate ship that drifts where the championship will be held; find it and put its crew to rest.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a pirate's spyglass and gold

quests.title: The Trophy Wall
quests.summary: The society hall in Reece has an empty wall: mount three of your best catches on fish mounts and trophy frames.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a fish mount of choice

quests.title: Silas Adrift
quests.summary: Silas went out in a storm to practise in secret and never came back; find him clinging to a wanderer's raft far out at sea and bring him home.

quests.title: The Angler's Almanac
quests.summary: Fill the society's almanac: catch every freshwater and saltwater species Aquaculture knows, from minnow to muskellunge.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a neptunium hoe and tackle

quests.title: Old Whiskers
quests.summary: Every swamp has a tale of a catfish as big as a boat; this one is true. Lure Old Whiskers up from the deepest swamp pool and land him alive in a bucket.

quests.title: The Lighthouse Semi-Final
quests.summary: The semi-final at a lighthouse, against Silas and the champions of two other villages: the first to land the lighthouse keeper's silver mackerel wins (a quest item). Fish until it bites.

quests.title: The Grand Championship
quests.summary: Every village sends its best to the grand championship, fished from a boat by the sea-dragon bones. The title goes to whoever lands the legendary golden sturgeon (a quest item); fish until it bites. Silas, now an ally, holds your net.

quests.title: The Last Cast
quests.summary: The Commodore's last challenge: cast a line in the black water over the Sunken City, where the Leviathan sleeps, and bring back a deepling's catch nobody has ever landed. She hands you the society's own rod.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, Tidecaller (neptunium rod: Luck of the Sea III, Lure III, Unbreaking III, Mending)
